column1: # Unsafe budget baseline (tools/lint/unsafe_budget.py): unsafe blocks, fns, impls and
# attributes per crate, tests excluded; forbid = every crate root carries
# #![forbid(unsafe_code)]; share = for a kernel crate, the percent of its code
# lines that are in files with unsafe (- outside the kernel). @unsafe-share:
# the same over all kernel crates, per mille. Counts, forbid and the kernel set
# must equal the tree; a count that grew, a lost forbid, a kernel crate that
# joins without one, or a share above its line fails. Update in
# the same commit (python3 tools/lint/unsafe_budget.py --update); a growth needs
# its reason in the commit message.
